comment: Gzipped byte budgets (DESIGN §11.8). 'enforce' budgets fail CI (the SPEC's critical path: main <150 KB). 'track' budgets only warn; they guard against growth. worker+wasm (DESIGN's ~300 KB estimate) is core's yrs, import/export zip, YAML frontmatter and Unicode tables plus Yjs, off the critical path since §22 item 69; sqlite is upstream sqlite-wasm.
